name: udixio-ui-governance
description: Audit, synchronize, and create Udixio UI components across React, Angular, Svelte, core behavior, accessibility, and documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Govern React, Angular and Svelte components without drift.
interface.longDescription: Audits long-lived public API design, component quality, accessibility, shared contracts, React-Angular and React-Svelte parity, tests, and documentation. It proposes durable contracts before repair or synchronization and can create complete Material 3 components for all three adapters.
defaultPrompt: Audit Button end to end and fix every verified issue.
Review a component public API and propose stable names before synchronization.
Synchronize the Angular component from its React source.
Synchronize the Svelte component from its React source.
Create a Material 3 component for React, Angular and Svelte.
